svg.title: Space Drums
svg.desc: Animated banner: two drumsticks play a seven-piece virtual drum kit (crash, ride, hi-hat, snare, two toms and a floor tom, laid out as in the app) under a starfield; the title reads Space Drums, play a drum kit in mid-air with fingers or sticks and one webcam.
svg.text: GRADUATION PROJECT · COMPUTER VISION · CAUSAL PREDICTION
Play a drum kit in mid-air.
Fingers or sticks. One webcam. A seven-piece kit.
